name: FALCON submarine cable landing station, Al Ghaydah (TeleYemen)
notes: Control side: Mahra under Saudi-led-coalition-backed local administration (DCD: FALCON lands in Al Ghaydah, currently under Saudi-led coalition control). Submarine Networks lists TeleYemen Al Ghaydah cable landing station for FALCON (B/A for existence); World Bank 2023 broadband-redundancy study treated FALCON as one of Yemen's only two active subsea cables. Landing station is a small strategic connectivity facility, not a commercial DC; no capacity data.

name: PTC/YemenNet DATA CENTER hosting facilities (Sana'a)
notes: Control side: Ansar Allah/Sana'a. Saba (Sana'a) report 2023-06-01 (verified live this run): PTC offers secure, cooled, cabinet-equipped server-hosting space in PTC-owned DATA CENTER facilities; 69 companies hosted in the first half of the reporting year; 467 sites hosted under the .ye portal; claims uninterrupted power, fire protection and dedicated high-speed internet line. A for service/facility existence; no MW, rack count or street address disclosed. State-carrier/institutional DC, not commercial colocation.

name: TeleYemen Sana'a international gateway / HQ (26-Sept, Al-Tahreer)
notes: Control side: building in Ansar Allah-held Sana'a; TeleYemen itself is a dual-authority entity (HQ Sana'a, IRG branch in Aden). TeleYemen HQ/international gateway housed telco equipment, servers, hosting and data services (Sana'a Center policy paper Jan 2021); DCD reported the building destroyed by a Saudi-led coalition airstrike Feb 2022, with TeleYemen saying it would resume services. Current status unverified -> unknown. Not commercial colocation; capacity null.

name: National Information Center (NIC) national data systems (yemennic.net)
notes: Control side: Sana'a/Ansar Allah variant of the dual NIC (an IRG-side successor/mirror is tracked separately). NIC builds and manages the national information system, databases and government data services (A for institutional data-hosting role; physical facility B/C - no server-room/data-center page found this run). Portal live 2026-08-12. Not commercial colocation.

notes: Control side: Ansar Allah/Sana'a. Directory-only listing (Data Center Platform) placing the YemenNet-PTC facility at Aljeraf Street, Sana'a; no primary (PTC/YemenNet/Saba/CSO) corroboration of address or capacity found this run - keep C. Operational status unknown.

name: Yemen Mobile core network (Sana'a) - state operator core lead
notes: Control side: state operator with core centered in Sana'a (Ansar Allah-held); ~40% subscriber share in 2019 per YE methodology. Methodology-identified state-carrier core-network lead; no public facility page or capacity spec found this run (network-level only, unverified facility) - C/U. Sabafon, YOU and legacy Y Telecom cores in Sana'a are similar B/C leads without public DC evidence.
